PART III - LANDS
NOTICE CALLING FOR CLAIMS TO PROPERTY OF INTESTATE
REGISTRATION OF TITLE ACT NO. 21 OF 1998
(SECTION 55)

Reference the intestate property of late Mr. Panawannage Saranapala who resided in the village of Pitipana South, in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Homagama, in the District of Colombo. It is hereby notified that any person/s who have a claim to or interest in the intestate property of the late Mr. Panawannage Saranapala described in the Schedule hereto should submit his/their claim to the undersigned in writing before 21st March 2017 stating his/their right or interest to such intestate property. In case of failure to do so, expert action will be taken to register title under Section 55 (2) and (3) of the Registration of Title Act. No. 21 of 1998. K.A.K.RANJITH DHARMAPALA, Commissioner of Title Settlement. Land Title Settlement Department, No. 1200/6, “Mihikatha Madura”, Rajamalwatta Road, Battaramulla. 08th February, 2017
SCHEDULE Divisional Village Cadastral Parcel No. Extent of Land Certificate Office of Secretary’s Division Map No. of Title No. Registration

(Hectare) Homagama Pitipana South 520007 Block 24 0.0287 0031631: Homagama Parcel No. 0068 Colombo N.B.- Letters claiming a right to intestate property should mention the Cadastral Map number, parcel number and the entitlement of the claimant to claim such property. The top left-hand corner of the envelope should bear the phrase “Application for Intestate Property.” 03 - 219 / 1
